node.statement: Global definition, regularity, and basepoints: under the root hypotheses, every U bold-dot V and U^dagger belongs to S_delta; hence mu(U,V)=u_delta(U bold-dot V) and sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger) are defined on all of calU and take values in calU. They are C^1, and mu(J,U)=mu(U,J)=U, sigma(J)=J.
